overview: HumanPCR introduces a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in human-centric visual understanding across Perception, Comprehension, and Reasoning levels, emphasizing proactive multi-evidence reasoning to diagnose model limitations.

modules.name: Task Taxonomy Definition Module
modules.description: Implements the hierarchical taxonomy structure (Perception, Comprehension, Reasoning) with 9 dimensions and 34 fine-grained task definitions, mapping each task to required data sources and evaluation criteria.

modules.name: Multi-Source Data Construction Module
modules.description: Handles the aggregation and pre-processing of data from diverse sources including public academic datasets (Ego4D, ActivityNet, etc.) and internet videos, with domain-tagging and initial content filtering for safety and relevance.

modules.name: Multiple-Choice QA Generation Module
modules.description: Automates the creation of Human-P and Human-C questions using template-based and LLM-based generation from existing dataset annotations, including distractor option generation and blind filtering to ensure visual dependency.

modules.name: Open-Ended Reasoning Annotation Module
modules.description: Supports the expert-driven annotation pipeline for Human-R, enforcing criteria for visual complexity, reasoning necessity, and proactivity, and capturing Chain-of-Thought rationales with key visual evidence timestamps.

modules.name: Quality Control & Verification Module
modules.description: Implements the multi-stage review process including automated LLM-based blind filtering, human verification for multiple-choice QA, and the meta-review checklist for Human-R to validate objectivity, complexity, and evidence requirements.

modules.name: Unified Data Loader & Sampler Module
modules.description: Provides custom Dataset and DataLoader implementations to handle mixed modality data (images, multi-images, videos) with configurable frame sampling strategies, and supports both multi-choice and open-ended QA formats.

modules.name: Model Evaluation Runner Module
modules.description: Orchestrates the evaluation of various MLLMs (open-source and proprietary) with configurable prompts (Direct Answer, CoT), frame counts, and test-time scaling strategies (Best-of-N, Self-Refine), managing API calls or local inference.

modules.name: Core Metrics Calculation Module
modules.description: Computes evaluation metrics including macro-average accuracy per task/dimension/level for multiple-choice questions, and uses an LLM-as-a-judge mechanism for scoring open-ended answers against reference CoT and ground truth.

modules.name: Error & Evidence Analysis Module
modules.description: Performs fine-grained error categorization (visual evidence extraction, knowledge, perception, etc.) and analyzes the retrieval of proactive vs. referred visual evidence, supporting intervention studies with guided hints.

modules.name: Comparative Benchmark Module
modules.description: Facilitates comparison against existing benchmarks (Video-MME, HumanVBench, etc.) by evaluating models on their subsets or formats, calculating bias metrics (text-only, single-frame performance), and generating comparison tables.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Study Module
modules.description: Configures and runs ablation experiments to analyze the impact of frame sampling numbers, different video understanding configurations (token selection, retrieval), and the effect of CoT prompting across different task dimensions.

modules.name: Judge Reliability & Statistical Validation Module
modules.description: Validates LLM-based judges against human annotations, computes Pearson correlation for rankings and win-loss preferences, and performs self-bias testing using statistical tests (e.g., Welch's t-test) on judge outputs.

modules.name: Visualization & Report Generation Module
modules.description: Generates publication-ready visualizations including performance bar charts, error distribution plots, evidence requirement graphs, and result tables formatted for LaTeX, aggregating data from all analysis modules.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Management Module
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations via YAML/JSON files, handles logging to files and integration with experiment tracking tools, and provides utilities for checkpointing evaluation runs and reproducibility of results.
